input._script:
using Base64, JSON3, Random
const PAYLOAD_B64 = ""
root = mktempdir(get(ENV, "WORK", "/tmp"))
write(joinpath(root, "p.tgz"), base64decode(PAYLOAD_B64))
run(`tar -xzf $(joinpath(root, "p.tgz")) -C $root`)
tf = joinpath(root, "out.txt")
io0 = open(tf, "w")
redirect_stdout(io0) do
    include(joinpath(root, "STADE.jl", "test", "vcg_lib.jl"))
end
close(io0)
cfg = JSON3.read(ARGS[1])
name = String(cfg["name"]); scale = String(cfg["scale"]); BES = [String(x) for x in cfg["backends"]]; t0 = time()
OUTS = Dict("ph_jacobi2d"=>[:u], "ph_cg_laplace2d"=>[:x], "ph_power_iter"=>[:lam], "ph_gs1d"=>[:u], "ph_kepler_newton"=>[:ea], "ph_colebrook"=>[:fric],
            "ph_saha_bisect"=>[:xion], "ph_react_diffuse"=>[:u], "ph_heat_steps"=>[:u], "ph_mg_solve"=>[:u])
# (int args, values) at the requested scale; maxit is filled in afterwards for the kernels that report their trips
function mk(name, scale, rng)
    big = scale == "big"
    if name == "ph_jacobi2d"
        nint = big ? 32 : 5; n = nint + 2
        f = zeros(n, n); f[2:n-1, 2:n-1] = randn(rng, nint, nint)
        (Dict(:nint=>nint), Dict(:u=>zeros(n,n), :v=>zeros(n,n), :f=>f, :h2=>0.07, :tol=>1e-20, :its=>zeros(Int,1)))
    elseif name == "ph_cg_laplace2d"
        nint = big ? 32 : 5; n = nint + 2
        b = zeros(n, n); b[2:n-1, 2:n-1] = randn(rng, nint, nint)
        (Dict(:nint=>nint), Dict(:x=>zeros(n,n), :b=>b, :r=>zeros(n,n), :p=>zeros(n,n), :ap=>zeros(n,n), :tol=>1e-20, :its=>zeros(Int,1)))
    elseif name == "ph_power_iter"
        n = big ? 256 : 9
        (Dict(:n=>n), Dict(:c=>2.0 .+ 2.0 .* rand(rng, n), :x=>fill(1 / sqrt(n), n), :y=>zeros(n), :lam=>zeros(1), :tol=>1e-12, :its=>zeros(Int,1)))
    elseif name == "ph_gs1d"
        n = big ? 64 : 12
        f = randn(rng, n); f[1] = 0.0; f[n] = 0.0
        (Dict(:n=>n), Dict(:u=>zeros(n), :f=>f, :h2=>0.05, :tol=>1e-20, :its=>zeros(Int,1)))
    elseif name == "ph_kepler_newton"
        n = big ? 20000 : 6
        (Dict(:n=>n), Dict(:mean_anom=>2.0 .* rand(rng, n) .+ 0.2, :ecc=>0.1 .+ 0.7 .* rand(rng, n), :ea=>zeros(n), :tol=>1e-14))
    elseif name == "ph_colebrook"
        n = big ? 20000 : 6
        (Dict(:n=>n), Dict(:re=>10.0 .^ (4 .+ 3 .* rand(rng, n)), :rough=>10.0 .^ (-5 .+ 2 .* rand(rng, n)), :fric=>zeros(n), :tol=>1e-13))
    elseif name == "ph_saha_bisect"
        n = big ? 20000 : 6
        (Dict(:n=>n), Dict(:s=>10.0 .^ (-1 .+ 2 .* rand(rng, n)), :w=>1.0 .+ 0.5 .* rand(rng, n) .* [1 + 2 * mod(i, 6) for i in 1:n], :xion=>zeros(n), :tol=>1e-9))
    elseif name == "ph_react_diffuse"
        n = big ? 20000 : 9
        (Dict(:n=>n), Dict(:u0=>0.5 .+ rand(rng, n), :v=>zeros(n), :u=>zeros(n), :kap=>0.8, :dt=>0.3, :nu=>0.2, :tol=>1e-14))
    elseif name == "ph_heat_steps"
        n = big ? 4096 : 10
        (Dict(:n=>n, :nsteps=>3), Dict(:u=>randn(rng, n), :w=>zeros(n), :wn=>zeros(n), :lam=>0.4, :tol=>1e-20, :its=>zeros(Int,1)))
    else  # ph_mg_solve
        L = big ? 12 : 4; nfine = 2^L; nm = nfine - 1
        f = zeros(nm, L); f[:, 1] = randn(rng, nm)
        (Dict(:nfine=>nfine, :num_levels=>L, :nu1=>2, :nu2=>2), Dict(:u=>zeros(nm, L), :f=>f, :r=>zeros(nm, L), :h1=>1.0 / nfine, :tol=>big ? 1e-12 : 1e-18, :its=>zeros(Int,1)))
    end
end
FIXED_MAXIT = Dict("ph_kepler_newton"=>20, "ph_colebrook"=>40, "ph_saha_bisect"=>60, "ph_react_diffuse"=>30)
rec = Dict{String,Any}("name"=>name, "scale"=>scale)
rng = MersenneTwister(7)
(I0, V) = mk(name, scale, rng)
wexpr = STADE.io_read_corpus_entry(joinpath(root, "STADE.jl", "test", "battle-corpus", name * ".jl"))
cexpr = STADE.io_read_corpus_entry(joinpath(root, "STADE.jl", "test", "counted-corpus", "phc_" * name[4:end] * ".jl"))
wk = STADE.parse_kernel(wexpr); ck = STADE.parse_kernel(cexpr)
# the while kernel on the CPU: reference result and its trips
wargs = STADE.val_primal_call_args(wk.sig, I0, deepcopy(V))
Base.invokelatest(STADE.val_compile(wexpr), wargs...)
wout = Dict(a => v for (a, v) in zip(wk.sig.args, wargs))
trips = haskey(V, :its) ? Int(wout[:its][1]) : -1
maxit = haskey(FIXED_MAXIT, name) ? FIXED_MAXIT[name] : ceil(Int, 1.2 * trips) + 2
I = merge(I0, Dict(:maxit => maxit))
rec["trips"] = trips; rec["maxit"] = maxit; rec["sizes"] = Dict(String(k) => (v isa AbstractArray ? size(v) : v) for (k, v) in merge(I0, V) if !(k in (:its,)))
Vc = Dict{Symbol,Any}(k => v for (k, v) in V if k != :its)    # the counted kernels report no trip count
cargs = STADE.val_primal_call_args(ck.sig, I, deepcopy(Vc))
Base.invokelatest(STADE.val_compile(cexpr), cargs...)
cout = Dict(a => v for (a, v) in zip(ck.sig.args, cargs))
rec["primal_counted_vs_while"] = maximum(maximum(abs.(cout[a] .- wout[a])) / max(maximum(abs.(wout[a])), 1e-300) for a in OUTS[name])
# the CPU adjoint of the while kernel in stack mode: time
function seeds_for(kern, V, rng)
    sd = STADE.val_random_values_like(kern, V)
    for a in keys(sd); a in OUTS[name] || (sd[a] = sd[a] isa Number ? 0.0 : zeros(size(sd[a]))); end
    sd
end
seed = seeds_for(ck, Vc, rng); tseed = STADE.val_random_values_like(ck, Vc); tsh = STADE.val_random_values_like(ck, Vc)
wseed = seeds_for(wk, V, rng)
adw = STADE.stade_adjoint(wexpr; keep_push_pop = true)
awf, awi = STADE.val_compile(adw.adjoint), STADE.val_compile(adw.initstacks)
STADE.val_call_adjoint(awf, awi, wk, I0, deepcopy(V), wseed)
rec["t_cpu_while_stack_adjoint"] = minimum(@elapsed(STADE.val_call_adjoint(awf, awi, wk, I0, deepcopy(V), wseed)) for _ in 1:2)
rec["modes"] = Dict{String,Any}()
bk = STADE.cgen_backend_cuda()
atomic = Expr(:., :Atomix, QuoteNode(Symbol("@atomic")))
tapebytes(st) = sum((s isa AbstractArray ? length(s) * sizeof(eltype(s)) : 0 for s in st); init = 0)
for mode in (:adjoint, :hvp)
    mrec = Dict{String,Any}()
    try
        gen = mode == :hvp ? STADE.stade_hvp(cexpr; keep_push_pop = false) : STADE.stade_adjoint(cexpr; keep_push_pop = false)
        genexpr = mode == :hvp ? gen.hvp : gen.adjoint
        san = Symbol[a for a in gen.initstacks.args[1].args[2:end]]
        for be in BES
            if time() - t0 > 700; mrec[be] = Dict("status" => "skipped (time budget)"); continue; end
            brec = Dict{String,Any}()
            try
                if be == "cuda"
                    pi_ = STADE.stade_gpu(gen.initstacks, bk)
                    pg = STADE.stade_gpu(genexpr, bk; init_hosts = Dict{Symbol,Expr}(pi_.host.args[1].args[1] => pi_.host))
                    pi_ = merge(pi_, (host = STADE.cgen_shrink_stacks(pi_.host, pg.dead_stacks, pg.compact_stacks),))
                    wrap = CuArray; tohost = Array; am = bk.atomic_macro
                else
                    pi_ = STADE.stade_jacc(gen.initstacks)
                    pg = STADE.stade_jacc(genexpr; init_hosts = Dict{Symbol,Expr}(gen.initstacks.args[1].args[1] => gen.initstacks))
                    wrap = x -> JACC.array(x); tohost = x -> JACC.to_host(x); am = atomic
                end
                r = gval_check_backend(ck, I, Vc, [seed], gen, pi_, pg, san, wrap, tohost, am; mode = mode, tan_seeds = [tseed], shtan_seeds = [tsh], truth = (name in ("ph_colebrook", "ph_cg_laplace2d")))
                brec["truth_ok"] = r.truth_ok; brec["tr_cpu"] = r.tr_cpu; brec["tr_dev"] = r.tr_dev
                brec["status"] = (r.ok || r.truth_ok) ? "ok" : (r.vacuous ? "VACUOUS" : "FAIL"); brec["max_rel_err"] = r.max_rel_err; brec["changed"] = r.elements_changed
                # time and tape, after the warm-up inside gval_check_backend
                cpu_fn = getfield(Main, gen.initstacks.args[1].args[1]); cpu_gen = getfield(Main, genexpr.args[1].args[1])
                dev_init = getfield(Main, pi_.host.args[1].args[1]); dev_gen = getfield(Main, pg.host.args[1].args[1])
                dvals = mode == :hvp ? tseed : Dict{Symbol,Any}(); dsd = mode == :hvp ? tsh : Dict{Symbol,Any}()
                tc = Float64[]; td = Float64[]; tape = 0
                for rep in 1:2
                    ca, _ = gval_build_call(ck.sig, I, Vc, seed, identity; mode = mode, dvalues = dvals, dseed = dsd)
                    sc = gval_live_init_stacks(cpu_fn, gval_stack_extra(san, I, Vc, identity))
                    push!(tc, @elapsed Base.invokelatest(cpu_gen, ca..., sc...))
                    da, _ = gval_build_call(ck.sig, I, Vc, seed, wrap; mode = mode, dvalues = dvals, dseed = dsd)
                    sd2 = gval_live_init_stacks(dev_init, gval_stack_extra(san, I, Vc, wrap))
                    tape = tapebytes(sd2); CUDA.synchronize()
                    push!(td, @elapsed (Base.invokelatest(dev_gen, da..., sd2...); CUDA.synchronize()))
                end
                brec["t_cpu_counted"] = minimum(tc); brec["t_dev"] = minimum(td); brec["tape_bytes_dev"] = tape
                brec["stack_names"] = String.(san)
            catch e
                brec["status"] = "exception"; brec["msg"] = first(sprint(showerror, e), 600)
            end
            mrec[be] = brec
        end
    catch e
        mrec["status"] = "gen_error"; mrec["msg"] = first(sprint(showerror, e), 600)
    end
    rec["modes"][String(mode)] = mrec
end
println(JSON3.write(rec))
input.name: ph_gs1d
